items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Instinctive (Body/Gut).

children.label: Repressed center
children.value: Instinctive: the paradox of the 9, uses bodily energy to stabilize the environment rather than to act on it.

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Both inward and outward: seeking balance to avoid disturbance.

items.label: Central issue
items.value: Maintaining autonomy and inner peace in the face of a world perceived as intrusive.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (Avoidance)
items.value: Avoid conflict and tension at all costs.

items.label: Passion (Vice)
items.value: Sloth (Acedia): a laziness of consciousness, a reluctance to mobilize and fully engage.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Indolence / self-forgetting: setting aside one's priorities for secondary things.

items.label: Defense mechanism
items.value: Narcotization: numbing itself with routines/distractions (TV, food, habits) so as not to feel discomfort or anger.

items.label: Egotic pride
items.value: I am fine, calm, and easygoing.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Loss of connection, separation, fragmentation.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Peace of mind and wholeness.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Appetite (comfort seeker): small material pleasures to compensate for a lack of attention to being.

children.label: Social
children.value: Participation: works hard for the group, forgets its own needs to offset a feeling of not belonging.

children.label: One-to-one (Sexual)
children.value: Union / merging: fusion with a person or an ideal in order to feel that it exists.

items.label: Social style
items.value: Withdrawn: withdraws to protect its autonomy and avoid being pushed around.

items.label: Conflict management
items.value: Positive Outlook: minimizes, focuses on the positive to maintain harmony.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 8 (more assertive, down-to-earth) and wing 1 (more idealistic, conscientious).

items.label: Integration (Growth)
items.value: → 3: becomes active, values itself, takes charge of its priorities, acts for itself.

items.label: Disintegration (Stress)
items.value: → 6: anxious, distrustful, reactive, preoccupied with others' opinions.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Love: reality is fundamentally good and loving, in a non-localized way.

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Right action (activity): engaging with vitality and intention in what is essential.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: Living Daylight (gold): the support of a benevolent, universal presence.

children.label: Specific difficulty
children.value: Inferiority: feeling unimportant or unworthy of love.

children.label: Specific reaction
children.value: Falling asleep: becoming unconscious of one's desires and of objective reality.

children.label: Specific illusion
children.value: Localized love: believing that goodness is outside oneself and inaccessible within.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner little 3: a need to be seen and to shine, hidden behind the 9's modesty.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Sagas / epic tales: details and multiple points of view, at the risk of drowning out the essential.

items.label: Communication misunderstanding
items.value: Appeasement-Vagueness: peaceful neutrality perceived as indecision or a lack of clarity.

sections.title: Evolution and relationships
sections.desc: Warning signs, growth practices, confusions, interactions.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: Getting lost in routines, becoming stubborn/inert, denying obvious health or financial problems.

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Identifying anger, defining one's priorities, practicing self-remembering, acting even amid discomfort.

items.label: Common confusions
items.value: 2 (helpfulness), 5 (calm/withdrawal).

children.label: In love
children.value: Supportive and gentle; can become emotionally absent out of fear of conflict.

children.label: At work
children.value: Stable mediator; can passively sabotage if pushed too hard.

levels.text: Self-possessed guide: presence, active peace, quiet strength.
Receptive person: deep listening, openness, stability.
Supportive peacemaker: harmony, mediation, firm kindness.
Accommodating role-player: adapts, forgets itself, avoids tension.
Resigned fatalist: gives up, dissolves, passivity.
Reality-denying doormat: self-effacement, denial, flight from the real.
Dissociated automaton: numbness, routines, inner cutoff.
Self-abandoning ghost: the disappearance of desire, the extinguishing of the self.

items.label: Consciousness
items.value: Moving from a zombie-like sleep state to self-remembering.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: GREEN (consensus, group harmony, empathy).

items.label: Analogy
items.value: A mirror: absorbs the other's image until it forgets its own presence.
